subject.title: fix: require exact claims for direct cloud cleanup

question: Should this PR wait for exact-head Vultr live lifecycle proof, or should maintainers explicitly waive the Vultr provider gate for this security fix?
rationale: The code path is security-sensitive and the PR itself says Vultr remains credential-blocked, so automation cannot decide whether the missing provider proof is acceptable before merge.

options.title: Wait for Vultr proof

options.title: Waive Vultr proof for this PR
